transit.label: Transit (single moment)
transit.hint: Sky at the selected moment → aspects to the natal chart

forecast.label: Transit calendar
forecast.hint: Aspects, sign ingresses, stations, eclipses and Moon phases over a period

solar_arc.label: Solar arc
solar_arc.hint: All points advanced by the progressed Sun's arc

solar_return.label: Solar return
solar_return.hint: Chart of the Sun's return to its natal position (birthplace)

lunar_return.label: Lunar return
lunar_return.hint: Chart of the Moon's return to its natal position (birthplace)

synastry.label: Synastry
synastry.hint: Aspects between two people's charts + house overlays

relocation.label: Relocation
relocation.hint: Same birth moment, new location: ASC/MC/houses

local_space.label: Local Space
local_space.hint: Horizon directions at the birth moment (compass + map)

fixed_stars.label: Fixed stars
fixed_stars.hint: Positions of 43 fixed stars at the birth moment + ecliptic longitude conjunctions with natal points

profections.label: Annual Profections
profections.hint: One sign per year of age from the Ascendant (whole sign houses): the year's active house, sign and classical ruling planet

extra_points.label: Extra points
extra_points.hint: Optional sections: asteroids (Ceres, Pallas, Juno, Vesta), seven Hermetic lots, Black Moon Lilith mean + true

planetary_return.label: Planetary returns
planetary_return.hint: Chart of the moment Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus or Mercury returns to its natal longitude; in a retrograde cycle a crossing is selected

transit_scan.label: Transit Scan
transit_scan.hint: Scans transiting planets' aspects to natal points over the selected date range: orb entry/exit, exact moment(s), stations and sign ingresses

classical_dignities.label: Classical Dignities and Almuten
classical_dignities.hint: Essential and accidental dignity scores, receptions, house almutens, chart almuten; default school William Lilly (1647)

declination_parallels.label: Declination parallels
declination_parallels.hint: Exact moments of parallel (same declination) and contraparallel (opposite declination) contacts between two bodies in the selected month — sky calendar; birth data is not used

d1.label: Vedic D1 (Rashi)
d1.hint: Sidereal kundli: Lagna, grahas, nakshatra/pada, yogas

drishti.label: Graha Drishti
drishti.hint: Parashari whole-sign graha drishti — Lahiri only

ashtakavarga.label: Ashtakavarga
ashtakavarga.hint: Bhinna/Sarva bindu grid, Shodhana, Shodhya Pinda

shadbala.label: Shadbala
shadbala.hint: Six-fold graha strength (BPHS), ratio and ranking

panchanga.label: Janma Panchanga
panchanga.hint: Birth-moment tithi, nakshatra, nitya yoga, karana; optional detailed day (vara, sunrise, Rahu Kaal…) and planetary hours (hora) + Choghadiya — Lahiri only

transit.label: Gochara (Vedic transit)
transit.hint: Sidereal grahas at the selected moment → house from the Janma Rashi / Lagna, whole-sign drishti, kaksha — Lahiri only

bhav_chalit.label: Bhav Chalit
bhav_chalit.hint: Bhava (Sripati) house cusps, madhya and sandhi; grahas' chalit bhava compared with the D1 rashi house

chara_karaka.label: Chara Karakas
chara_karaka.hint: Jaimini: Atmakaraka … Darakaraka; degree ranking; 8-karaka (Rahu included) or 7-karaka scheme

arudha.label: Arudha Padas
arudha.hint: Jaimini: Arudha Lagna (AL), A2…A11, Upapada (UL); lord, count and the 1st/7th house exception

bhava_bala.label: Bhava Bala
bhava_bala.hint: Strength of the 12 houses: Bhavadhipati, Dig and Drishti Bala; total and ranking (separate from Shadbala planetary strength)

dasha.label: Vimshottari Dasha
dasha.hint: Mahadasha timeline; sub-periods load on click down to Prana level; current period chain optional

varga.label: Vedic Varga (D9 Navamsa / Dn)
varga.hint: Divisional chart: D9 by default; D2…D60 selectable; vargottama

gun_milan.label: Gun Milan (Ashtakoot)
gun_milan.hint: 8 koota scores (out of 36) from both people's Moon nakshatra / sign, Nadi / Bhakoot dosha and classical cancellation, Manglik for both — technical assessment

monthly.label: Vedic monthly timing
monthly.hint: Sidereal (Lahiri) sky calendar of the selected month: planetary sign ingresses, exact astronomical aspects between planets and with the Moon, declination parallels; optional birth-moment declinations. Not graha drishti

sade_sati.label: Sade Sati
sade_sati.hint: Saturn's gochara through the 12th / 1st / 2nd house from the Janma Rashi: status and phase on the assessment day only (period start / end dates are not in this version)

dashakoot.label: Ten Porutham (Dashakoot)
dashakoot.hint: South Indian matching: 10 porutham criteria (met / not met), total out of 10, strict Rajju and Vedha constraints; a system separate from Gun Milan — technical assessment

papasamyam.label: Papasamyam
papasamyam.hint: Malefic contributions of Mars, Saturn, the Sun and Rahu in houses 1-2-4-7-8-12 from the Lagna / Moon / Venus in both charts, weighted totals and comparison — technical assessment

upagraha.label: Upagrahas
upagraha.hint: 11 calculated sensitive points: time-based (Gulika, Mandi, Kala, Mrityu, Ardhaprahara, Yamaghantaka) and Sun-derived (Dhuma, Vyatipata, Parivesha, Indra Chapa, Upaketu); sign, degree, nakshatra, pada

heliacal.label: Graha Asta / Udaya
heliacal.hint: Whether the six visible grahas are free of the Sun's glare (kalamsa) on the selected day and observation place, last and next heliacal rising / setting; birth time not required

chart.label: KP birth chart
chart.hint: Placidus cusps, sign / star / sub / sub-sub lord, 4-level significators (KP-Newcomb)

dasha.label: KP dasha
dasha.hint: Vimshottari (KP ayanamsa) + KP significators of the period lords; sub-periods on click

ruling.label: KP ruling planets
ruling.hint: Ruling planets of the selected moment + their natal significators

transit.label: KP transit
transit.hint: KP sky at a single moment or Sub-Lord / Rasi changes over a time range; no natal house analysis

horary.label: KP horary (1–249)
horary.hint: Number + question moment + assessment place; birth data is not used

ruling_interval.label: KP ruling planets time scan
ruling_interval.hint: Ruling planets step by step over the selected range, Lagna/Moon lord chain and significators from that moment's chart; birth data is not used

d.forecast: {start} + {days} days{end} ({parts, plural, one {# part} other {# parts}}){tz}
d.profections: profection year at age {age} · whole sign
d.horaryUnverified: local time zone could not be verified; showing UTC

reason.transitMoment: transit moment is invalid (see the preview)
reason.riWindow: scan duration / step is invalid (at most 24 hours, at most 121 moments)
reason.chainDate: complete the current period chain date / time
reason.chainMoment: current period chain moment is invalid
reason.extraSections: select at least one extra point section
reason.monthlySections: select at least one monthly calendar section
reason.kpRangeStart: complete the KP range start date
reason.kpRangeDays: the KP range can be at most {max} days
reason.kpPositionsDays: the KP position table can be at most {max} days
reason.scanDates: complete the start and end dates
reason.scanOrder: the end cannot be before the start
reason.scanMax: scan range is at most 1 year ({days} days)
